verdict.rationale: Open WebUI issues API keys, but the docs describe them as personal access tokens that call the same endpoints as the web UI, so a key appears to carry its owner's full access rather than a scoped one. Least privilege is only implied: an admin could create a dedicated low-trust user under the RBAC role system and issue that user's key to an agent, but no doc describes doing this. Missing for 10: per-key scopes or permissions, agent-specific or service-account credentials, documented binding of key permissions to RBAC, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
